summary: Phibro Animal Health Corp filed a Form 8-K announcing a quarterly cash dividend of $0.12 per share on Class A and Class B common stock, payable June 24, 2026, to holders of record June 3, 2026. This is a routine capital allocation event, not a special situation. The board declared the dividend without any strategic review, activism, or restructuring. There are no deal terms, advisors, or unusual mechanics. What to watch: future dividend declarations for sustainability.
